plugins.description: 适用于dsh的会话同步插件及配套可自部署服务器
plugins.readme_text: # dsh-session-sync 给 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）做的**会话云同步**：自部署服务端、端到端加密，同步会话与附件；设备台账、agent 笔记与多工作区映射见 [docs/VAULT.md](docs/VAULT.md) 设计稿。 > **状态：M1/M2 已完成，M3 已完成，M4 进行中。** 帧工具/加密、服务端（含管理台与初始化）、M0 免重启 ingest 已经可跑；M3 的推送/拉取、安全边界、双 home E2E、durable journal 与错误退避已通过。M4 已完成 A1–A5、B1–B5（凭据、设置页、首启向导）、C1–C4/C6（composer block、列表拦截、行标记、同步气泡）与 E1（`batches` 规范字段）；剩 C5 GUI 回归、D5 故障文案演练与 E3 文档收口。里程碑见 [docs/ROADMAP.md](docs/ROADMAP.md)。 ## 支持版本 DSH `>=0.2.1-rc.1 <0.2.2-0`。0.2.1 之前缺少本插件依赖的能力（如 `appendPluginRecord`），不做兼容。 ## 目录 ``` packages/shared/ 帧处理（多帧 zstd）、端到端加密、线上类型；插件与服务端共用 packages/plugin/ DSH 宿主插件（install_bundle 的目标目录） packages/server/ 自部署服务端：node:http + node:sqlite + blob 目录，零运行时依赖 tests/ 临时 DSH home 的硬约束与夹具（见 tests/README.md） docs/ 设计、协议 ``` ## 开发 ```sh pnpm install pnpm test # node --test（.ts 由 Node 24 直接运行） pnpm typecheck pnpm check # typecheck + test pnpm fixtures # 重新生成夹具的 .zstd 兄弟文件 pnpm dev:server # 在 .tmp/dev-data 起服务端（127.0.0.1:8787） pnpm dev:dsh # 起隔离的 DSH 开发实例（默认端口 3090） pnpm dev:console # 起 M0 控制台（127.0.0.1:3091，见 tests/m0/README.md） ``` 夹具由官方 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-session` 校验器验证（`packages/shared` 的 devDependencies，版本与 DSH 对齐）。 **首次启动服务端**：控制台会打印一次性初始化密钥，并提示打开 ；按向导设置管理密码、存储配额，可选创建第一台设备。之后管理台用密码登录；忘记密码执行 `node packages/server/src/index.ts admin reset`（重启后重新打印初始化密钥）。 ### 隔离的 DSH 开发实例 `pnpm dev:dsh` 会： - 把 `DSH_HOME` 指到 `.tmp/dev-dsh/home`； - 用 `--patch` 覆盖 `workspace-controller` 的 `documentsDirectory`，让**默认工作区**落在 `.tmp/dev-dsh/documents/`（否则 DSH 会建到系统 Documents 下）； - 清掉从当前会话继承的 `DSH_*` 变量，避免新实例误以为自己在嵌套运行。 需要保留已登录状态时：`node scripts/dev-dsh.mjs --credentials <旧 home 的 .credentials.yaml>`。脚本拒绝在 `.tmp/` 之外创建实例目录。 ## 两条硬约定 - **测试绝不碰真实 `~/.dsh`**：所有临时 home 经 `tests/helpers/tmp-home.mjs` 创建，位于 `.tmp/` 且被 git 忽略；规则与断言清单见 [tests/README.md](tests/README.md)。 - **仓库文档写我们的选择与中性事实**，不评价其他项目。 ## 文档 - [docs/ROADMAP.md](docs/ROADMAP.md)：M0–M4 里程碑、当前状态与文档地图。 - [docs/M4-PLAN.md](docs/M4-PLAN.md)：M4 工作项、依赖顺序与待拍板项。 - [docs/DESIGN.md](docs/DESIGN.md)：范围、数据分层、并发与加密的取舍。 - [docs/VAULT.md](docs/VAULT.md)：加密附加数据层、多工作区映射、设备台账与插件版本匹配（设计稿）。 - [docs/CWD.md](docs/CWD.md)：cwd/工作目录事件处理：header canonical、事件 raw、接收端修正。 - [docs/DECISIONS.md](docs/DECISIONS.md)：cwd/Canonical 反复讨论后的最终决策记录。 - [docs/PROMPT-GUIDANCE.md](docs/PROMPT-GUIDANCE.md)：agent 提示词规划：尽量不把会话 cwd 切到工作区外。 - [docs/RECONCILE.md](docs/RECONCILE.md)：会话身份、raw 前缀校验、默认自动同步与冲突/忽略流程。 - [docs/GLOSSARY.md](docs/GLOSSARY.md)：术语表（Canonical、生命周期、workspaceKey、对账等）。 - [docs/USAGE-AGREEMENT.md](docs/USAGE-AGREEMENT.md)：使用协议草案（修改边界、加密边界、风险告知）。 - [docs/PROTOCOL.md](docs/PROTOCOL.md)：服务端端点与不变量。 - [docs/SYNC-SAFETY.md](docs/SYNC-SAFETY.md)：开放尾与安全边界、拉取原子性、客户端防误操作。 - [docs/UI-GUIDELINES.md](docs/UI-GUIDELINES.md)：客户端页面的动效与可访问性约定。 - [dev/ui/README.md](dev/ui/README.md)：设置页 / 首启 / 同步气泡的静态原型。 - [tests/README.md](tests/README.md)：临时 home 与夹具约定。 ## 许可证 本仓库按目录拆分许可： - **`packages/server/**`：AGPL-3.0-only**（[全文](LICENSES/AGPL-3.0-only.txt)）。对外提供修改后的服务端时，需按 AGPL §13 向使用者提供对应源码；个人自部署、仅自己使用不受影响。 - **`packages/plugin/**`、`packages/shared/**` 及其余部分：MIT**（[全文](LICENSES/MIT.txt)）。 根目录的 [LICENSE](LICENSE) 是拆分范围的简短说明；各 package 目录下也各有一份对应全文。

plugins.description: 期刊投稿状态定时检查插件（Editorial Manager 确定性抓取 + AI 回退 + 设置面板）
plugins.readme_text:
# @dsh-external/dsh-paper-checker

检查学术期刊投稿审稿状态并定时汇报的 DSH 插件。

- **Editorial Manager 期刊**：内置确定性 Playwright 抓取（Playwright 内置 Chromium，无头模式；浏览器目录可用 `browserPath` 配置）。
- **自动识别稿件阶段**：主菜单上所有「活跃投稿分区」自动抓取（审稿 submission / 修改 revision / 生产 production），报告按分区分组 + 摘要统计三阶段篇数。
- **已决策稿件**：自动抓取 `Submissions with a Decision`（含拒绝/接受结果），但只在决策后 7 天内列进报告（避免历史决策刷屏），独立分组「📂 近期决策（7 天内）」。
- **其他投稿系统**（`system: 'other'`）：返回「回退信号」，由 AI 用浏览器工具交互式处理（方案 C 混合模式）。
- **守护定时**：每天到点自动检查 → 写报告 → 推微信（Server酱）。
- **按需工具**：`check_paper_status`，agent 可随时调用。
- **设置面板**：DSH「设置 → 投稿检查」里可视化配置时间/时区/期刊列表，并支持「自动识别」新期刊。

## 安装

本插件是标准 dsh bundle（package.json 声明 `dsh.bundle.patch`，自带 `cordis.patch.yml`），可被官方 CLI 直接识别安装。

### 前提

- DSH 客户端（任意 profile，示例用 `web`）。
- 命令行里有 `dsh` 与 `pnpm`（DSH 插件管理的标准工具链）。
- Playwright Chromium 浏览器：运行一次 `npx playwright install chromium` 下载（约 300MB），或在设置面板配置 `browserPath` 指向已准备好的浏览器目录（见下）。

### 方式一：官方 CLI（推荐）

```bash
cd <tgz 所在目录>
dsh plugin --profile web add ./dsh-external-dsh-paper-checker-0.0.1.tgz
```

（相对路径会被 CLI 锚定到你的调用目录；也可用绝对路径 `dsh plugin --profile web add E:/path/to/dsh-external-dsh-paper-checker-0.0.1.tgz`。）

`dsh plugin add` 会：
1. 把 tgz 装进 profile（依赖 `playwright-core` 一并安装）；
2. 检测到本包声明了 `dsh.bundle`，自动把 `@dsh-external/dsh-paper-checker` 写入 profile 的 `dsh.profile.bundles` 启用名单。

装完**重启 DSH** 即可在「设置」里看到「投稿检查」面板，按需配置期刊后生效。

> 没有 `pnpm` 时先 `corepack enable pnpm`（Node 18+ 自带 corepack）或 `npm i -g pnpm`。

### 方式二：插件市场（若客户端装了 plugin-market / zat-dsh-engine）

把本仓库发布到 GitHub 并打上 `dsh-plugin` topic 后，在市场的「安装」入口搜索即可一键安装（市场同样会写启用名单）。

### 方式三：手动（无 dsh CLI 时）

```bash
cd <DSH_HOME>/profiles/web
pnpm add file:/绝对路径/dsh-external-dsh-paper-checker-0.0.1.tgz
# 然后编辑 <DSH_HOME>/profiles/web/package.json，
# 确保 dsh.profile.bundles 数组里含 "@dsh-external/dsh-paper-checker"，重启 DSH。
```

## 配置

安装后推荐在「设置 → 投稿检查」面板里配置（可视化 + 可自动识别新期刊）。配置持久化到 `settings.yaml` 的 `paper-checker` 命名空间。

配置结构（也可直接编辑 settings.yaml）：

```yaml
journals:
  - name: '某期刊名'
    baseUrl: 'https://www.editorialmanager.com/xxxx'
    username: 'your-email@example.com'
    password: 'your-password'
    sections:
      - 'Submissions Being Processed'
      - 'Submissions Needing Revision'
    # sections 可选：面板「自动识别新期刊」会探测主菜单全部投稿分区并自动写入（含当前 0 篇的），
    # 之后每次检查按此抓取、出现新稿件即被抓到，无需手动维护；手动加分区也可以，优先抓取
    system: 'editorial-manager'   # 默认；'other' 则回退给 AI
  - name: '某非 EM 期刊'
    baseUrl: 'https://example.com/submit'
    username: 'xxx'
    password: 'xxx'
    sections: []
    system: 'other'               # 回退：AI 用浏览器工具处理

time: '08:00'                     # 每天触发时间 HH:mm
timezone: 'Asia/Shanghai'         # IANA 时区
scheduleEnabled: true             # 是否启用守护定时
serverchanKey: 'SCTxxxx'          # Server酱 SendKey；留空则不推微信
reportDir: ''                     # 报告目录；留空默认 ~/.dsh/paper-checker/reports
reportSessionId: ''               # 可选：检查结果同步汇报到某个对话会话
discoverProvider: ''              # 可选：自动识别新期刊用的模型 Provider（留空用全局默认）
discoverModel: ''                 # 可选：自动识别新期刊用的模型（留空用全局默认）
browserPath: ''                   # 可选：Playwright 浏览器目录（PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH 的目录名布局）。
                                  #   留空用系统默认 %LOCALAPPDATA%\ms-playwright。
                                  #   若插件报「Executable doesn't exist at ...chromium_headless_shell-XXXX...」，
                                  #   在目录下放置对应的 chromium_headless_shell-XXXX\chrome-win\headless_shell.exe 即可。
```

## 字段说明

| 字段 | 类型 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| `journals[].name` | string | 期刊显示名 |
| `journals[].baseUrl` | string | EM 站点根地址（如 `https://www.editorialmanager.com/xxx`） |
| `journals[].username/password` | string | 登录凭据 |
| `journals[].sections` | string[] | 要检查的分区名；面板自动识别新期刊时探测主菜单全部分区自动写入，之后检查按此抓取（可选，留空则靠自动发现补抓） |
| `journals[].system` | 'editorial-manager'\|'other' | 抓取方式；EM 确定性，other 回退 AI |
| `time` | 'HH:mm' | 每天触发时间 |
| `timezone` | IANA 时区 | 如 Asia/Shanghai |
| `scheduleEnabled` | bool | 是否开启守护定时 |
| `serverchanKey` | string | Server酱 key，推微信用；空则跳过 |
| `reportDir` | string | 报告输出目录 |
| `reportSessionId` | string | 检查结果同步汇报的会话 id（可选） |
| `discoverProvider` / `discoverModel` | string | 自动识别新期刊所用模型（可选，留空用全局默认） |
| `browserPath` | string | Playwright 浏览器目录（可选；留空用系统默认 %LOCALAPPDATA%\\ms-playwright） |

## 输出

- 报告写入 `{reportDir}/report-{date}.md` 和 `latest.md`，运行日志 `run.log`。
- 报告按分区分组列出每篇稿件（`- 📂 分区名（计数）` → `- [状态] 稿件号: 标题（投稿/更新/截止）`），末尾摘要统计三阶段：`审稿 N 篇 · 修改 N 篇 · 生产 N 篇`；若有 7 天内决策的稿件，追加独立分组「📂 近期决策（7 天内）」与摘要 `· 近期决策 N 篇`。
- 微信推送（若配置了 `serverchanKey`）标题 `📊 投稿状态报告 (日期)`。
- 工具 `check_paper_status` 返回中文报告文本。

## 依赖

- Playwright Chromium：运行 `npx playwright install chromium` 下载（默认位置 `%LOCALAPPDATA%\ms-playwright`）；也可用 `browserPath` 指向自备目录（含 `chromium_headless_shell-XXXX\chrome-win\headless_shell.exe`）。
- `playwright-core`（声明为 dependency，安装时自动带入；确定性抓取驱动 Playwright 内置 Chromium）。

## 说明

- Editorial Manager 登录兼容两种形态：直接表单 / 折叠在「Alternatively, use your username and password」里。- 新增期刊自动探测：面板「自动识别新期刊」登录后确定性探测主菜单上**全部**投稿分区（含当前 0 篇的分区，按菜单顺序，排除 Task Assignments 任务区与 with Production Completed 已完成历史）写入 `sections`，模型只识别期刊名/系统类型（期刊名可能识别不准，面板里可直接修改后加入）；保存后每次检查按探测结果抓取，count=0 分区自动跳过、一有稿件即被抓到。老配置未写 `sections` 时，检查时自动发现 count>0 的投稿分区补抓（排除 New Submissions 入口与 with Production Completed 已完成历史）。
- 已决策分区：`Submissions with a Decision` 也自动纳入抓取（跨分页遍历全部历史，最多 8 页），报告层只显示决策日期在最近 7 天内的稿件；决策日期取 Status Date / Final Decision Date / Decision Date 列。
- 表格兼容：`table#datatable` 与 `table#GridSubmissions`（表头在 tbody 首行 `<th>`）两种 EM 结构都能解析。
- 状态翻译：Under Review→审稿中、In Production→生产中、Needs Author Action→等待作者操作、Major/Minor Revision→大修/小修、Awaiting Author Approval→等待作者确认 等 40+ 状态，另有前缀/关键词模糊匹配（含 Reject 即→已拒稿、含 Accept 即→已接受、含 Revis 即→修改中，可覆盖 Completed - Reject / Completed - Accept 等组合状态）。
- 非 EM 期刊（`system: 'other'`）在守护定时中仅标记「需 AI 检查」，交互式调用 `check_paper_status` 时由 AI 用浏览器工具完成。

## 构建（开发者）

产物 `lib/index.js`（host，自包含，已内联 `@deepseek-ai/*` 依赖）与 `lib/client.js`（client 面板）已随包分发，使用者无需构建。如需改代码后重打：

```bash
npm install            # 安装 typescript / tsdown / @types/node
npm run build:client   # tsdown 打包 host + client 到 lib/
npm pack               # 产出 tgz
```

plugins.description: Cut model-facing tokens out of tool output before it enters a request. A global DeepSeek Harness plugin: lossless normalization, annotated repetition collapse, and recoverable structure-aware trimming.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-context-diet

A global DeepSeek Harness plugin that removes tokens from tool output **before**
that output can enter a model request — without removing anything the model may
need, and without changing what the model is able to do.

```
tests/t0.py::case PASSED
tests/t1.py::case PASSED
…
[... 12235 of 12416 characters omitted by dsh-context-diet; 4 diagnostic lines
 retained, middle elided ...]
______________________ test_charge_card_rejects_expired _______________________
src/payments/charge.py:118: in charge_card
E   CardExpiredError: card expired 2024-01-31
FAILED tests/test_payments.py::test_charge_card_rejects_expired
[…]
…899 tests collected…
(Trimmed 12235 characters. Full normalized result stored at:
 /…/session-…/bash.txt. Use read with offset/limit, or grep this path.)
```

## The problem it solves

Every tool result becomes part of the conversation the moment it is logged, and
from then on the model re-reads it on every step of the session. The shipped
`dsh-compaction-tool-result-pruner` only trims **once a compaction trigger
qualifies**, and rewriting a result that late invalidates the prompt-cache prefix
that was already established — so trimming late costs extra as well as saving.

`dsh-context-diet` runs at `tools/post-execute`, the last waterfall before the
registry freezes a result into a `tool/result` event. A rewrite there belongs to
the call it came from: there is no cache prefix to invalidate, no second copy to
reconcile, and no durable edit to replay.

## What it removes

### 1. Lossless normalization (on by default)

Reduces output to what a terminal would actually display. A terminal shows no
glyph for an escape sequence, so removing one cannot change meaning.

| Transform | Example | Result |
|---|---|---|
| Escape sequences | `\e[31merror\e[0m` | `error` |
| OSC hyperlinks and titles | `\e]8;;http://x\a link` | `link` |
| Carriage-return overlays | `10%\r50%\r100%` | `100%` |
| Backspace erasure | `ab\bc` | `ac` |
| Trailing whitespace | `a   \n` | `a\n` |
| Blank-line padding | `a\n\n\n\n\nb` | `a\n\nb` |

### 2. Annotated compaction (on by default)

A run of at least `repeatThreshold` (8) byte-identical consecutive lines that is
also at least `repeatMinRunChars` (1000) characters long becomes one line naming
the exact repeat count:

```
npm warn deprecated inflight@1.0.6: This module is not supported…  [x400 identical lines omitted by dsh-context-diet]
```

The run is collapsed **only when the annotation is strictly shorter than the run
it replaces**, so this pass can never enlarge a result. The count is preserved, so
the run is exactly reconstructible from the annotation and nothing is dropped
silently — which is why this pass needs no recovery file.

### 3. Recoverable, structure-aware trimming (on by default above 32,000 characters)

A result still larger than `maxInlineChars` is replaced by:

1. its head (`headChars`),
2. an omission marker stating exactly how much was dropped,
3. **the diagnostically significant lines from the omitted middle** — errors,
   failures, exceptions, assertions, stack frames, diff hunks and headers, and
   `file:line:col` references (`significantChars`), and
4. its tail (`tailChars`),

followed by a notice naming a spill file that holds the complete normalized text,
with the backend's own retrieval guidance.

Blind head/tail cutting discards the middle unconditionally. Keeping the
diagnostic lines makes the same budget **strictly more informative**, not less —
measured on a 900-test `pytest -v` run, every one of `CardExpiredError`,
`charge.py:118`, `test_charge_card_rejects_expired`, and `1 failed, 899 passed`
survives with this plugin and is lost by a head/tail cut of the same size.

## Why quality is not affected

- **Nothing is dropped without a record.** Every removal is either a
  control character a terminal never displays, or something that is counted,
  annotated, and written verbatim to a spill file the notice tells the model how
  to read.
- **`read` is exempt by default.** File-content output is line-addressed: blank-line
  or trailing-whitespace rewriting would corrupt content a model may quote back
  at an editor. This matches the shipped `dsh-spill-policy`, which exempts `read`
  for the same reason.
- **The default budget is conservative.** No result under 32,000 characters —
  roughly 8,000 tokens — is touched at all, except by the lossless passes.
- **It cannot alter capability.** It registers no tools, removes none, changes no
  prompts, and changes no model or reasoning settings. Tool schemas, the system
  prompt, and the tool catalog are byte-identical to a run without it, so the
  prompt cache behaves exactly as before.
- **It never makes a model call and never adds a request.**
- **It fails open.** Any unexpected shape, missing service, or thrown error
  returns the incoming result untouched and logs a warning. `verify.mjs` covers
  each of those paths.

## Measured effect

On a synthetic but realistic bash-heavy corpus (900-test `pytest -v`, `npm install`
with 400 repeated deprecation warnings, 2,400-line `cargo build`, a `curl`
progress bar, and a 3,000-entry `find`), with shipped defaults:

| Result | Before | Model sees | Removed |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| `pytest -v`, buried failure | 48,002 | 12,555 | 74% |
| `npm install`, 400 repeats | 33,711 | 236 | 99% |
| `cargo build`, buried error | 158,997 | 20,218 | 87% |
| `curl` progress bar | 4,572 | 61 | 99% |
| `find` over a large tree | 130,890 | 12,218 | 91% |
| **Total** | **376,172** | **45,288** | **88%** |

The lossless tier alone accounts for 15% of that; the rest is annotated
compaction and recoverable trimming. Character counts are not billed tokens —
the figures are indicative, and `/diet` reports the real numbers for the session
you are in.

### Verified against a running Harness

Both passes were exercised live, through the real `tools/post-execute` waterfall
of a running `dsh web` profile, using the real `dsh-spill-local` backend:

```text
$ for i in $(seq 1 30); do echo "SAME LINE PADDING PADDING PADDING PADDING PADDING"; done
SAME LINE PADDING PADDING PADDING PADDING PADDING  [x30 identical lines omitted by dsh-context-diet]
```

```text
$ awk '… 570 lines with an error at line 285 …'
download asset 0000 of 0570 ================================================
…
[... 31890 of 43967 characters omitted by dsh-context-diet; 1 diagnostic lines retained, middle elided ...]

src/engine/pipeline.rs:204:7 - error TS2345: UNIQUE_BURIED_DIAGNOSTIC_MARKER

[...]
…
download asset 0569 of 0570 ================================================

(Trimmed 31890 characters. Full normalized result stored at:
 /…/c1cbcd405966-bash.txt. Use read with offset/limit, or grep this path to search within it.)
```

The 43,967-character result reached the model as 12,077 characters (72% smaller),
the diagnostic line that a head/tail cut would have dropped was retained, and the
recovery file was verified to hold all 571 lines of the original output.

## Install

```sh
# 1. install the package into a profile
dsh plugin --profile web add link:/path/to/dsh-context-diet
```

2. Enable the bundle: **Settings → Plugins → Installed → dsh-context-diet → on**.
   An agent driving the plugin manager does both steps at once with
   `install_bundle`.

The bundle inserts one global Host row, so it applies to every session in the
profile — not to a single session. It needs no credentials and no other plugin;
the `tools/post-execute` seam is part of `dsh-tools`, and the spill backend comes
from `dsh-spill-local`, both of which the shipped compositions provide. Without a
spill backend the plugin still normalizes and compacts, and simply declines to
trim, because trimming without a recovery file would lose information.

## Configuration

Every field is optional; omitting it keeps the shipped default. Override any of
them in the profile's own `cordis.patch.yml`, which is applied after bundle
layers and therefore survives plugin upgrades:

```yaml
- id: context-diet
  name: 'dsh-context-diet'
  config:
    maxInlineChars: 64000     # 0 keeps only the lossless and annotated passes
    exemptTools: ['read', 'read_image']
    repeatTh

plugins.description: Session cost and remaining provider balance below the DeepSeek Harness Web composer.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-cost-meter

A DeepSeek Harness plugin that shows one ambient line below the Web composer:
the estimated model cost of the current session **and of every subagent session
it started**, plus the remaining balance of the provider route in use.

```
[ Composer card                                 ]
      Cost $0.1306 · Balance $12.50
```

Hovering a pill shows its breakdown: token buckets per model route, how much of
the total came from subagent sessions, per-request fees, and topped-up versus
granted credit for the balance.

## What the number includes

- **This session**, priced from the usage the provider reported in its own log.
- **Every subagent session it delegated to**, transitively. A subagent runs as a
  separate Session with its own log, so the parent's log names its children
  (`subagent/catalog`) but never their usage; the plugin reads each child's own
  projected cost instead — from the live Session while the app still holds it,
  from the child's durable checkpoint once it has settled, and by re-folding that
  child's own log where no checkpoint can serve it (see below).
- **Per-request fees** for calls that are billed outside token usage, currently
  DeepSeek Search/Fetch requests at $0.75 per 1,000 successful requests. A
  request event records the request, not its usage, so this is a stated estimate.

If a child session cannot be read at all — no live Session and no checkpoint
whose lifecycle matches — the plugin does not pretend it cost nothing. It marks
the total as a lower bound (`at least $0.1306`) and says how many sessions were
unreadable, rather than showing a number that looks exact.

Why a total can still differ from <https://platform.deepseek.com>'s usage log:
that page bills an account, so it also covers sessions this machine never ran and
any other client using the same key. Auxiliary model calls whose usage is never
recorded (session titles, and the DeepSeek-side search calls a search request can
fan out to, up to `maxUses` per request) are billed by DeepSeek but are invisible
to any log-based reader. The plugin therefore estimates from what the logs
record, and labels that estimate as one.

## Requirements

- DeepSeek Harness with the Web app (`dsh web`). The balance read needs the
  `connection` and `credentials` services, which the shipped Web composition
  provides.
- For the balance pill, a wallet endpoint plus a stored credential for it; the
  built-in default is DeepSeek's Platform balance endpoint with a
  `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY` credential reference. Cost needs nothing: prices ship in the
  row config.

## Install

```sh
# 1. install the package into a profile
dsh plugin --profile web add github:dsh-plugin-db/dsh-cost-meter

# …or from a local checkout
dsh plugin --profile web add link:/path/to/dsh-cost-meter
```

2. Enable the bundle: **Settings → Plugins → Installed → dsh-cost-meter → on**.
   (An agent driving the plugin manager does both steps at once with
   `install_bundle`.)

The package ships a bundle patch, so enabling it inserts the row with built-in
defaults. Cost works immediately; the balance pill appears once a wallet source
answers. The credential reference is resolved on the Host, so the secret never
reaches the browser.

## Configuration

Every value lives in the row config, so it survives DSH upgrades in the
profile's own `cordis.patch.yml` (highest-priority layer):

```yaml
- id: dsh-cost-meter
  name: 'dsh-cost-meter'
  config:
    prices:
      - provider: '*'        # '*' matches any route; a literal provider wins over '*'
        model: deepseek-flash
        currency: USD
        input: 0.3           # per 1M cache-miss input tokens
        output: 1.2          # per 1M output tokens
        cacheRead: 0.006     # per 1M cache-hit input tokens
        cacheWrite: 0.3      # optional; defaults to `input`
        offPeak:             # optional; used outside `peakWindows`
          input: 0.15
          output: 0.6
          cacheRead: 0.003
          cacheWrite: 0.15
    peakWindows:             # optional; defaults to DeepSeek's published windows
      - { startHourUtc: 1, endHourUtc: 4, weekdaysOnly: true }
      - { startHourUtc: 6, endHourUtc: 10, weekdaysOnly: true }
    balances:                # optional; provider route → wallet endpoint
      - provider: deepseek-official
        url: https://api.deepseek.com/user/balance
        credential: DEEPSEEK_API_KEY   # credential reference resolved in the Host
        auth: bearer                   # or x-api-key
        timeoutMs: 10000
    fees:                    # optional; Session events that are billed per request
      - event: web/deepseek-search-llm-request
        label: Search
        per1kRequests: 0.75  # DeepSeek Search/Fetch list price, USD
        currency: USD
```

Lookup specificity is `provider+model` → `provider+*` → `*+model` → `*+*`. A
route with no matching row still shows its token count, and the cost pill is
prefixed with "at least" while unpriced calls exist, so an estimate never
pretends to be complete.

A `fees` row counts the Session events of that exact type and bills them per
1,000 requests, outside token pricing, which is how DeepSeek bills its Search and
Fetch calls. The default row covers `web/deepseek-search-llm-request`, the event
the Web app's DeepSeek search feature records for each search request. Set
`fees: []` to price tokens only.

Shipped defaults are DeepSeek's published list prices for `deepseek-flash` and
`deepseek-v4-pro` (per 1M tokens, USD) with their peak/off-peak windows, and the
Search/Fetch per-request fee. Prices change; edit them in the profile patch.

## Balance

The Client reads the balance in two steps, and reports what it finds:

1. The signed-in DeepSeek account through `ctx.remote.account.getBalance`, for
   routes whose provider starts with `deepseek`.
2. This plugin's Host route, asked for the exact route the session is spending
   on. The Host matches that provider against `balances` (an exact provider wins
   over `*`), resolves the named credential through `ctx.credentials`, calls the
   endpoint, and answers with the wallet amounts only.

A route the Host prices no wallet for (`unsupported-provider`) shows nothing, so
the pill never appears for a provider that simply has no `balances` row. Every
other outcome is visible: the amount when the wallets are read, and `Balance —`
with the reason in its tooltip when the credential is missing, the endpoint
fails, or the route does not answer at all. That reason carries the HTTP status
and the body, which separates the two silent failures: a browser sees
`404 not found` when this build's route is not mounted, and `401 unauthorized`
when the request never reached it.

The key never reaches the browser, and the endpoint is ordinary configuration:
another provider whose API returns a wallet needs a new `balances` row plus a
parser kind in `index.js`. Amounts are re-read once a minute; each pill carries
its own currency, so a USD cost and a CNY balance never get conflated.

## How it is built

| Half | File | Role |
|---|---|---|
| Host | `index.js` | Two `sessionProjections` units — `costMeter` (prices provider-reported usage and per-request fees) and `costMeterFamily` (this session plus every session it delegated to) — plus one balance route on Connection's `/api` channel |
| Client | `client.js` | One `conversation.composer.dock` entry that renders the family wire value, falling back to the session value, asking the Host for a family read while the projection is still incomplete, and reading the balance |

The Host folds the durable Session log and publishes two client-visible
projections; the Client renders them through the `useProjection` slot prop. Both
halves were written against documented seams only:

- `ctx.sessionProjections.register({key, stateVersion, stateSchema, init, apply, wire})` —
  projection units; the registry calls only `schema.parse`, so the schemas here
  are small hand-written normalizers with no schema-library dependency.
- The `SessionEvent` envelope and payloads: `request/header` (route),
  `assistant/message` / `assistant/attempt` (usage, from `data.usage` or the
  last `usage` chunk of the com

plugins.description: Free, dependable web_search and web_fetch for DeepSeek Harness: fused keyless search plus optional Brave, SSRF-safe retrieval with reader escalation.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-reliable-web

Free, dependable `web_search` and `web_fetch` for DeepSeek Harness — no paid
search API, no required sign-up, no model-specific integration. It plugs into
the Harness web seam (`ctx.web`), so every model and every agent preset that can
call the shipped web tools gets free retrieval with the same tool schemas,
result cards, timeout policy, and error handling.

## Why this design

The Harness already owns the model-facing contract: `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-web`
defines the `web_search` / `web_fetch` tools, their argument validation, HTML→markdown
conversion, result presentation, and cancellation. This plugin deliberately does
**not** reimplement any of that. It registers two providers on the documented
extension point:

| Capability | Provider id | Registered with |
|---|---|---|
| search | `reliable` | `ctx.web.registerSearchProvider()` |
| fetch | `reliable` | `ctx.web.registerFetchProvider()` |

That choice is what keeps it working across Harness releases:

- no import of any `@deepseek-ai/*` package and no npm dependency, so a profile
  install works even when Harness internals are not resolvable;
- only the two documented seam methods, plus plain result objects matching the
  published shapes;
- provider errors use the documented open-string `code` vocabulary;
- `Config` is a Standard Schema (`~standard.validate`), which Cordis validates
  natively — no schema library to drift.

## Activation and provider selection

The shipped composition pins `web.searchProvider: deepseek-official` and
`web.fetchProvider: http`. A static patch that replaced those ids would leave a
dangling reference if this plugin is later disabled: every web call in the
profile would fail with `WEB_PROVIDER_CONFIGURED_MISSING`.

Instead, the plugin **claims the selection at runtime**, only while the field
still holds an id it is explicitly allowed to replace (`takeOverSearchIds` /
`takeOverFetchIds`), and restores the previous value when it unloads. An id set
by `$DSH_WEB_SEARCH_PROVIDER` / `$DSH_WEB_FETCH_PROVIDER`, or any third-party
pin, is left untouched with a log line. Disabling the plugin therefore degrades
to the official provider instead of breaking search.

`takeOver: false` turns this off; then set the `web` row's provider ids to
`reliable` yourself.

## Search

A query fans out across free backends in waves of `searchFanout` concurrent
requests. Every default engine works without an account; several also use a key
when present to raise their limits, and Brave joins the chain only when a key is
configured.

| Engine | Key | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `exa` | `EXA_API_KEY` optional | public Exa MCP tier; semantic index |
| `parallel` | `PARALLEL_API_KEY` optional | public Parallel search MCP tier |
| `brave` | `BRAVE_API_KEY` required | official API; free monthly credit (about 1,000 requests at list price) |
| `tavily` | `TAVILY_API_KEY` optional | keyless access mode |
| `keenable` | `KEENABLE_API_KEY` optional | public `/search/public` tier |
| `anysearch` | `ANYSEARCH_API_KEY` optional | keyless public endpoint |
| `firecrawl` | `FIRECRAWL_API_KEY` optional | keyless monthly credit allowance |
| `duckduckgo` | — | independent HTML index, last-resort coverage |
| `wikipedia` | — | encyclopedic last resort |

### Brave (optional)

Brave is the one engine that is keyed by design: it is a strong independent
index and its prepaid plan includes a **free monthly credit** (currently $5,
which is about 1,000 requests at the $5/1,000 list price; some older plans show
a fixed monthly query allowance instead). The plugin reads the key from, in
order:

1. `braveApiKey` in the row config;
2. `BRAVE_API_KEY` (or `BRAVE_SEARCH_API_KEY`) in the process environment;
3. `$DSH_HOME/secrets/brave.key`, then `~/.dsh/secrets/brave.key`,
   then `~/.config/dsh-reliable-web/brave.key`.

Only the first non-empty line of the file is used, so a trailing newline is
fine. Keep the file at mode `600`. When no key is found, the engine is skipped
with a debug line and the keyless chain is unchanged. Brave's per-second limit
depends on the plan (the free tier is typically one request per second), so the
plugin spaces Brave requests about 1.1s apart; a single query is not delayed,
and a multi-query `web_search` call queues instead of tripping a 429.

**Never commit the key.** The repository ignores `.env*`, `.secrets/`, and
`*.key`; the recommended locations are outside it.

Quality comes from **fusion**, not from picking a favorite engine:

- each engine's per-result contribution is `weight / (k + rank)`, so a document
  several independent indexes rank highly outranks one that only a single index
  ranks first (reciprocal rank fusion);
- URLs are canonicalized for dedupe — fragments and tracking parameters folded
  out of the key, `www.` and scheme folded, trailing slashes folded, GitHub blob
  URLs collapsed across branch/commit refs; the displayed URL keeps its fragment
  but drops tracking parameters;
- snippets and titles come from the most authoritative engine that returned the
  document, with gaps filled by the others.

Reliability is separate from quality:

- a failed, throttled, or empty engine is cooled down (rate limits 60s, quota
  and auth 30min, transient 15s) and the chain continues;
- every engine shares one wall-clock budget (`searchBudgetMs`);
- a short TTL cache (5 min, 256 entries, LRU) serves repeated queries without
  touching any upstream, which matters on per-address free tiers;
- `truncated` is honest: it means sources were actually dropped, not merely that
  the requested count was reached.

If every non-cooling engine fails, the call throws a structured
`WEB_PROVIDER_ERROR` rather than pretending the web has no results. If engines
answer with nothing, it returns an empty successful result.

## Fetch

Retrieval escalates only when it must:

1. **direct**, SSRF-safe HTTP(S). No third party sees the URL. HTML is returned
   as `kind: 'html'` so the Harness's own converter produces the model-facing
   markdown. This is the fast path for ordinary pages.
2. **readers** (`jina`, `exa`, `firecrawl`), launched concurrently, only when
   direct was refused (401/403/406/429/451/503), is a bot challenge, is a
   client-rendered shell, or failed at the transport level. They render the page
   on their own infrastructure and return markdown, which recovers pages direct
   retrieval cannot see.
3. a definitive direct status such as `404`/`410` is returned as a result
   immediately — a reader would only repeat it slower.

A readable success always beats a bot wall or an error page. A `404` is a
result, not an exception. One deadline (`fetchBudgetMs`, 25s) covers the whole
chain, leaving headroom under the tool's 30s cooperative budget so a timeout is
reported precisely instead of as an opaque `TOOL_TIMEOUT`.

### SSRF and resource safety

The transport is self-contained and fails closed:

- only `http:`/`https:`, no embedded credentials, 2048-character URL limit;
- every hop is re-parsed, re-screened, and re-pinned, so redirects cannot
  escape the public-address policy;
- every resolved address must be public; loopback, private, link-local, CGNAT,
  benchmark, multicast, documentation, and reserved ranges are refused, for
  literals and resolved names alike;
- the connection is pinned to the validated address set, so a DNS answer cannot
  change between check and connect;
- response bytes, redirect hops, and converted characters are capped;
- decompression is bounded, so a compressed body cannot expand without limit.

`allowPrivateNetwork: true` exists for a local/intranet deployment and is off by
default; it is the one setting that lets a model reach cloud metadata and local
services.

## Configuration

The row is `reliable-web`. Every field is optional.

```yaml
- id: reliable-web
  name: 'dsh-reliable-web'
  config:
    # search
    engineOrder: ['exa', 'parallel', 'brave', 'tavily', 'keenable', 'anysearch', 'firecrawl', 'duckduckgo', 'wikipedia']
    disabledEngines: []
    searchBudgetMs: 25000
    searchFanout: 3
    searchTimeoutMs: 12000
    searchCacheTtlMs: 300000      # 0 disables the cache
    braveApiKey: ''               # prefer BRAVE_API_KE

plugins.description: Delete sessions from the DeepSeek Harness Web sidebar straight into a Trash settings page, then restore them or delete them permanently.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-session-trash

Delete sessions from the sidebar into a **Trash** page in Settings, then
restore them or delete them permanently.

A global [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)
plugin published as one npm package carrying both halves: a Host plugin mounted
by the bundle patch, and a browser half served from the same package's `./client`
export.

## Install

This package is a DeepSeek Harness **bundle**: `dsh.bundle.patch` is its Host
row, `dsh.client` is its browser half, and the package resolves both. Install it
into a profile with the harness's own Plugin Manager — point it at this
directory (or at the repository URL) and it records the bundle in the profile:

- `dsh` CLI, if the harness exposes the Plugin Manager surface:
  `dsh plugin --profile <name> add <source>`
- or add it to the profile's dependencies and bundle list directly, then boot.

The profile's own `cordis.patch.yml` is applied *after* this bundle's layer, so
it is also where any config below is pinned.

## What it adds

- A delete button at the end of every Session row in the sidebar, beside the
  shipped archive and pin buttons. **One press deletes**: the session goes
  straight to Trash with no confirmation step, because Trash is the undo.
- A **Delete session** row in the Session's `…` menu, for keyboard users and
  anyone who never hovers a row.
- A **Trash** page in Settings listing every deleted session, with
  **Restore** and **Delete permanently** per session and **Empty Trash** for
  the whole list. Permanently deleting a session drops its log and its derived
  projection cache; a live session cannot be trashed or purged. These two stay
  behind a confirmation, because they are the irreversible half.

### The deleted row leaves an open browser immediately

Moving a log aside makes the session absent from the Host catalog on the next
listing — but nothing schedules one. The browser's session store was filled by a
pull that already happened, so a deleted row would otherwise stay on screen (the
sidebar renders it as an ungrouped "stray") until the page was reloaded.

After the log actually moves, the Host therefore emits the declared Remote Event
`api-session/removed`, which Cordis relays to every connected client. That is the
same path the shipped Session controller uses for its own disposal
notifications (`dsh-api-session-controller/lib/index.js`), so the browser clears
the row through its ordinary list-mutation code — no client-side list surgery,
and no plugin knowledge of another package's internals. The route's response
reports `announced: false` if the relay was unavailable, so a deployment without
the event simply falls back to clearing on the next load.

## How deletion works

The Harness ships no session-deletion API: `SessionPersistence` creates, opens,
lists, and flushes handles but never removes one, and the browser session
controller exposes no delete verb. What the store does publish is its
addressing rule — a session is visible exactly when its directory holds a
canonical generation log (`session.jsonl`, `session.v<N>.jsonl`, either with the
configured compression suffix).

So deleting a session appends `.trashed` to that one basename inside the
session's own directory. Nothing is copied and the log's bytes are untouched:
`stat`/`list`/`open` all report the session as absent, so the sidebar catalog,
search, title folding, and lineage traces treat it as gone without knowing this
plugin exists. Restoring removes the suffix again, which brings the title back
with the log, and permanently deleting removes the directory and the session's
projection-cache record.

The trash index is this plugin's own plain JSON document. A missing, empty, or
hand-edited index is reconciled against the session root on every read, so a
trashed session is never stranded by index damage.

## Configuration

The row takes an optional `config`, set from the profile's own
`cordis.patch.yml` (the layer applied after this bundle's):

```yaml
- id: session-trash
  name: 'dsh-session-trash'
  config:
    # Defaults to $DSH_HOME/sessions, the session-persistence root.
    sessionsRoot: /absolute/path/to/sessions
    # Defaults to $DSH_HOME/storages/dsh-session-trash/index.json.
    indexFile: /absolute/path/to/index.json
    # Defaults to $DSH_HOME/storages/session_projcache/sessions.
    projectionCacheDir: /absolute/path/to/session_projcache/sessions
```

## Verification

Two dependency-free suites ship with the package and run against a scratch
session root in the system temporary directory:

```sh
node verify.mjs        # the store: trash, list, restore, purge, empty, recovery
node verify-route.mjs  # the route: dispatch, validation, refusals, envelopes
```

`verify.mjs` asserts the property this design rests on — a trashed session is
invisible to a canonical-generation scan while its bytes are byte-for-byte
unchanged, and restoring brings back the identical file.

## Upgrade stability

The Host half imports no Harness package; its one contribution is a
`connection.fetch` exact route on the authenticated `/api` channel, and the
store knowledge it relies on is the filename grammar above — a storage-format
constant rather than a module API, with `v<N>` left open-ended so a future
format generation is matched by the same scan. The browser half imports no
Harness Client package either: it uses the module-loader factory contract,
`ctx.slots.inject`/`register`, the slot's standard `useSessions` hook,
`ctx.locale`, and `--dsw-alias-*` theme tokens only.

# dsh-kankan-mail

[DSH](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) plugin exposing [kankan.email](https://kankan.email) (AI Agent mailboxes) as MCP tools. Zero dependencies — a single `mcp-server.js` Node script speaking NDJSON JSON-RPC over stdio.

## Tools

| Tool | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `create_mailbox(name_hint?)` | Create a mailbox; returns the address + `mail_key` (save the key!) |
| `list_messages(address?, key?, after_id?)` | List received messages (incremental via `after_id`) |
| `send_mail(to, subject, body, address?, key?)` | Send an email from the mailbox |
| `renew_mailbox(address?, key?)` | Renew the mailbox |
| `pay_order(order_no, method)` | Pay an order |
| `order_status(order_no)` | Query order status |

## Install

```bash
npx @deepseek-ai/dsh plugin --profile web add github:zhulianxing/dsh-kankan-mail
```

## Configuration

Set environment variables before launching DSH (they are forwarded to the MCP server):

- `KANKAN_ADDRESS` — default mailbox address (optional; can be passed per tool call)
- `KANKAN_MAIL_KEY` — default `mail_key` (optional; can be passed per tool call)

Note: outbound send uses the `X-Mail-Key` header carrying your `mail_key`. If kankan.email changes its auth header name, adjust `mailHeaders()` in `mcp-server.js`.

## License

MIT

# dsh-lookhere

[DSH](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) plugin exposing [lookhere.help](https://lookhere.help) (AI knowledge-base customer service) as MCP tools. Zero dependencies.

API verified against the lookhere.help codebase: owner endpoints use `Authorization: Bearer <JWT>`; chat is an async job — `POST /api/chat/:shareId` with `{ message }` returns `{ job_id }`, then poll `GET /api/chat/result/:jobId`. `ask_bot` does both for you and waits up to 60s.

## Tools

| Tool | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `list_bots()` | List your bots (auth) |
| `get_bot(shareId)` | Public bot info by share ID (no auth) |
| `ask_bot(shareId, question, history?)` | Ask a bot; submits the job and polls until answered |
| `chat_result(jobId)` | Poll one async job result manually |
| `bot_chats(botId)` | Latest 100 Q&A logs of one of your bots (auth) |

## Install

```bash
npx @deepseek-ai/dsh plugin --profile web add github:zhulianxing/dsh-lookhere
```

## Configuration

- `LOOKHERE_TOKEN` — **required** for owner endpoints (`list_bots`, `bot_chats`); your account JWT
- `LOOKHERE_BASE_URL` — optional override (default `https://lookhere.help`)

Note: jobs are in-memory server-side with a ~10 min TTL — expired job ids must be resubmitted.

# dsh-clawpay

[DSH](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) plugin exposing [clawpay.click](https://clawpay.click) (USDT on BSC payments) as MCP tools for merchants. Zero dependencies.

API verified against the clawpay.click codebase: auth via `Authorization: Bearer <api_key>`; create-order field is `amount_usdt`; address binding uses `bsc_address`.

## Tools

| Tool | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `create_order(amount_usdt, memo?, callback_url?, activation?)` | Create a payment order (or the merchant activation order); returns order no, exact expected amount, receiving address, cashier URL |
| `get_order(order_no)` | Order detail (auth) |
| `check_order_public(order_no)` | Public payment-status polling (no auth) |
| `list_orders()` | Latest 50 of your orders |
| `merchant_me()` | Merchant profile (status, address, callback, balance) |
| `set_address(address, callback_url?)` | Bind/update BSC receiving address (`0x` + 40 hex) and callback URL |

## Install

```bash

plugins.description: Cross-session call center for DeepSeek Harness (DSH) agents: session_message delivery between sessions + a named contacts directory with name-only self-registration. File-based config, local-only, no telemetry.
plugins.readme_text:
# DSH Agents in the Loop

Use [DeepSeek Harness (DSH)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) as the control center for Claude Code, Codex, and other external agents. Agents in the Loop gives an external client a workspace-backed DSH session identity, access to DSH tools over MCP, and an inbox for replies. Claude Code can act as the main orchestrator while DSH runs other agents and keeps its native task, workspace, and tool services together.

This provides a shared operating context without requiring a separate Mission Control application. External agents continue running in their own clients; the hidden DSH session supplies identity and workspace context. The integration includes named contacts, messaging, persistent workers, and a Web sidebar with system-backed provider/model/preset/workspace/permission selectors.

With full-tool exposure enabled, newly registered DSH tools become available through the endpoint without a separate adapter for each one. Clients may need to reconnect to discover changed schemas. Every added tool also expands what shared-key holders can do; read the security warnings before enabling this mode.

**Version:** `2.0.0`. Install the archive from the [GitHub release](https://github.com/markelayan/agents-in-the-loop/releases/tag/v2.0.0), or install from npm once that version has been published. See [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md) for upgrade changes.

All capability switches ship **disabled**. Installing the bundle does not enable messaging, spawning, MCP, inboxes, identities, or Mission Control. Configure only the capabilities you intend to use.

## Requirements

- DSH Web profile. This release is verified against **DSH `0.2.0-rc.2`**; other versions have not been validated for this release. DSH is a developer preview whose APIs can change.
- Node **22.13.0 or later in the 22.x line, or 23.4.0 and later**. The plugin imports built-in [`node:sqlite`](https://nodejs.org/api/sqlite.html); earlier Node versions need a flag or lack the module. This requirement applies even with inboxes disabled.
- Registered host providers/models, presets, and workspaces for features that use them. Provider authentication belongs to DSH.

There are no npm runtime dependencies and no install scripts. The plugin runs inside DSH and uses its existing Web server. SQLite is built into Node. Enabled workers can incur provider costs; the optional Mission Control bridge also makes network requests and launches a user-supplied script.

### Integration dependencies

| Component | When required |
|---|---|
| DSH Web server and native session/tool registries | Always; this is a DSH plugin, not a standalone control center |
| External client with streamable-HTTP MCP and configurable request headers | For Claude Code, Codex, or another external orchestrator |
| Built-in Node SQLite and writable local state directory | Inbox, identity metadata, and runtime overrides; SQLite module support is required at import |
| Installed DSH preset, registered workspace, and permission registry | Workspace-backed identities and spawned workers |
| Configured DSH provider/model with its supported authentication | Workers that invoke models; the external client keeps its own authentication |
| Native memory/taskboard or other DSH tool plugins | Only for the services those plugins provide; AITL exposes them rather than reimplementing them |
| Separate Mission Control server, key, templates, and spawn script | Only for the optional legacy MC bridge; unnecessary for DSH-centered orchestration |

### Subscription and authentication boundaries

The external client keeps its own supported login and subscription. AITL does not extract or proxy subscription credentials, convert a subscription into an API key, or bypass provider limits. A hidden DSH identity is session context, not a new provider entitlement. DSH workers use the provider integrations and authentication configured in DSH; they do not inherit the external client's subscription simply because that client started them.

Use only provider-supported interfaces and authentication, and review the current terms for each client/provider. See the official [Claude Code authentication guide](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/authentication) and [Codex authentication guide](https://developers.openai.com/codex/auth) for supported login methods. This plugin does not certify that a particular orchestration, automation, or subscription setup is permitted. API billing, subscription usage limits, and account permissions remain separate from plugin seat caps.

## Install and enable

For the prepared local archive:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add /absolute/path/dsh-agents-in-the-loop-2.0.0.tgz
```

After `2.0.0` has been published:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-agents-in-the-loop@2.0.0
```

You can also install through DSH's **Plugins** page. Installation selects the bundle automatically; do not insert a duplicate plugin row. Consult the [DSH documentation](https://deepseek-harness.github.io/deepseek-harness/) for profile management.

The shipped defaults are [cordis.patch.yml](cordis.patch.yml). Add an owner-controlled override to the Web profile's `cordis.patch.yml`, matching the plugin ID:

```yaml
- override:
    - id: dsh-agents-in-the-loop
      config:
        enabled: true
        sessionMessage:
          enabled: true
        contacts:
          enabled: true
```

Apply through DSH's supported reload/restart workflow. With HMR enabled, some composition changes apply immediately. Reconnect MCP clients after upgrades or tool enablement changes to refresh schemas. Do not edit the installed package's defaults: upgrades replace them.

Open the Agents in the Loop sidebar on **localhost**, using your DSH Web port. Panel APIs reject non-loopback connections even if DSH itself is reachable over a LAN. There is no fixed plugin port.

## Tools and delivery

| Tool | Purpose | Required feature |
|---|---|---|
| `session_message` | List sessions; send to a named contact | `sessionMessage.enabled` |
| `contacts` | List/get/add/update/remove named contacts; `call` a contact | `contacts.enabled` |
| `aitl_catalog` | Discover live model, preset, workspace, and permission choices | Plugin enabled and host registries available |
| `spawn_session` | Create and register a persistent worker | `spawn.enabled` |
| `inbox` | Poll/read/ack an external maildrop; send messages | `mcp.inbox.enabled` |

Examples below are tool arguments. Discover targets with `contacts`:

```json
{"action":"list"}
```

Send with `contacts`:

```json
{"action":"call","name":"reviewer","message":"Review the attached change and reply with the verdict."}
```

Register your native session with `contacts`:

```json
{"action":"add","name":"reviewer","label":"Code review"}
```

Omitting `sessionId` registers the caller. Registered native worker IDs and existing durable contact IDs are supported; discover actual IDs instead of guessing their format. Contact names use lowercase `[a-z0-9._-]`, up to 64 characters. `session_message.send` requires a contact name rather than a raw session ID. The panel/HTTP contact API validates optional `cwd` against registered workspace paths; the native contacts tool accepts absolute paths without that registry check. Contact metadata does not rebind a session-backed identity.

Idle sessions receive visible messages through a wake; busy sessions receive a visible notice. `wake` defaults to true; `resumeIfDead` defaults to false. A successful send means delivery was accepted, **not task completion**. Retrying sends can duplicate messages. Direct messages over the configured cap are truncated with a note; oversized inbox messages are rejected. Self-send is refused.

Load [SKILL.md](SKILL.md) for the agent-facing reference. Incoming message bodies are untrusted data; act only within the user's authorization.

## Dynamic worker selection

Enable `spawn.enabled`. Call `aitl_catalog {}` first and use IDs from its current result:

```json
{
  "name":"reviewer",
  "message":"<complete task brief and reply instructions>",
  "provider":"<provider-id>",
  "model":"<model-id>",
  "preset":"<preset-id>",
  "permission":"<permission-i

plugins.description: dsh的桌面宠物，挂载在WhaleHarbor中
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-whaleharbor-pet · 鲸娘桌宠

鲸港 WhaleHarbor 的**大白鲸娘桌面窗宠**：一只透明、置顶、不抢焦点的悬浮小鲸娘，实时反映 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）的工作状态。

形象采用 **2D 拆件 + CSS 纸片人动画**：原画拆成 13 个零件（底座/眼×4/嘴×6/呆毛/汗滴），底座擦除与表情件重组误差为 **0 像素**，动作全部由 CSS keyframes 驱动（呼吸、眨眼、呆毛摇摆、汗滴、蹦跳、抖动），60fps、缩放无损。

![鲸娘桌宠](docs/hero.png)

## 状态表情

![八种状态](docs/states.png)

| 状态 | 触发 | 表现 |
|---|---|---|
| 空闲 A/B | 无任务 | 呼吸浮动 + 眨眼 + 呆毛摇摆；两种 idle 每 18s 随机轮换（B 有快速双眨和视线偷瞄）；每 9s 轮换闲扯台词 |
| 忙碌 | 主 agent 运行 / 根工具执行 / 子代理 / 工作流 | 快速浮动 + 波浪嘴 + 汗滴滑落 + 冒泡，气泡显示当前工具名 |
| 审批等待 | `approval/request`（主 agent） | 头顶红色 `!` 徽章 + O 嘴 + 歪呆毛 + 提示气泡 |
| 提问等待 | `user-questions/request`（主 agent） | 头顶蓝色 `?` 徽章 + 瞳孔偏移 + 呆毛大摆 |
| 出错 | `agent/error`（主 agent） | XX 眼 + 高频抖动 + 橙色 `✕` 徽章 8 秒 |
| 完成庆祝 | 忙碌 → 空闲跳变 | 蹦跳三下 + ∩∩ 笑眼 + 开怀大笑 + 星星爱心 6 秒 |
| 打盹 | 连续空闲 3 分钟 | 慢深呼吸 + 闭眼 + 画面变暗 + `Z z z` |
| 子代理分身 | `subagent/start` 存活数 | 右下角小鲸鱼（最多 6 只） |

气泡副栏实时统计：本次开机工具调用数、累计忙碌分钟、被戳次数。

![桌面实拍](docs/desktop-2.png)

> 桌面实拍：忙碌状态（pwsh 工具运行中），气泡为实时统计，右下为子代理分身。

**支持平台**：需要 WhaleHarbor 桌面壳提供浮窗能力（当前发布 Windows 构建）；插件本体是纯 Web 技术（DOM + CSS 动画），壳支持更多平台后即随之可用。

## 交互

- **拖动**：按住鲸娘或空白处拖动（壳的 float-preload 实现，零页面协议）
- **戳一戳**：点击鲸娘 → 压缩回弹动画 + 随机吐槽，计数上报
- **右键**：原生菜单 —— 小号/中号/大号（重建浮窗，状态自动续上）、隐藏
- **托盘菜单**（WhaleHarbor 托盘）：状态行 + 「显示/隐藏鲸娘」
- **悬停**：显示状态气泡

## 架构

```
DSH 核心进程（本插件 Host 半部，index.js）
  │  监听 agent/status、tools/execute、approval/request、user-questions/request、
  │  subagent/start|end、workflow/start|end、agent/error（subagent 按 session header 过滤）
  │  聚合成 ≤2.5KB 状态快照
  ▼
RPC 桥  http://127.0.0.1:<随机端口>（DSH_DESKTOP_NOTIFY_PORT/_TOKEN，请求体上限 4KB）
  │  float.window.create（url 模式：内联 html 超 4KB 会被静默断开，
  │  页面与零件由插件本地服务器自取：/pet.html + /parts/*.png，路径白名单 404 兜底）
  │  → float.window.state（1s 节流，变化才推）
  │  float.window.menu（右键原生菜单）
  ▼
WhaleHarbor 壳：透明显示浮窗（floating 置顶 / focusable:false / 不进任务栏）
  ▲  反向通道（插件自起 127.0.0.1 eventPort）
  └── float.window.input（戳一戳）/ float.window.menu.click / float.window.closed
```

- 页面是一张零件叠加的 DOM：底座常驻，表情件按 mood class 切换透明度，动作全在 CSS keyframes（`translateY` 相对自身盒高，窗口三档尺寸自适应）。
- 零件缺失（打包漏发 `parts/`）时自动退回占位鲸鱼，不白屏。
- 桥不可达（纯浏览器/CLI 启动、旧壳、浮窗开关关闭）时**安静空转**，无任何副作用。
- 卸载/HMR/核心退出时 `ctx.effect` 清理：`float.window.closeAll` + 托盘分区清除 + 事件服务器关闭。
- 窗口是壳的资产：核心重启时代际清理，宠物不会变孤儿。

## 安装

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add @duke-dsh-plugins/dsh-whaleharbor-pet
```

> 国内网络请显式指定 `--registry=https://registry.npmjs.org`（本机默认 registry 常被镜像源覆盖）。

装完**必须重启 DSH 核心**生效（桌面壳 Ctrl+Alt+R 或设置 → 核心 → 重启）。

## 本地开发

```bash
node --check index.js                  # 语法检查
node -e "console.log(require('./index.js')._buildPetPage())"   # 导出浮窗页面
```

页面通过插件事件服务器提供 `/pet.html` 与 `/parts/*.png`；开发时用任意静态服务器指向本目录即可预览（支持 `?mood=idle-a|idle-b|busy|nap|celebrate|approval|question|error` 钉死状态）。

## 已知边界

- 改大小 = 关窗重建（浮窗宽高创建即固定），位置回到默认右下角。
- `float.window.state` 是替换最新值语义：页面刷新自动补发最新状态。
- 每插件浮窗限额 3 / 全局 6；本插件只用 1。

## License

[MIT](LICENSE) © dukebywwh

plugins.description: Per-workspace trust for DSH, used by other plugins to decide whether project code may run · 为 DSH 工作区记录信任，供其他插件决定是否运行项目里的代码
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-workspace-trust

给 DSH 工作区记录「信任 / 不信任」，供其他插件决定是否运行项目里的代码、能否访问工作区外的路径。

DSH 自带的没有工作区信任：克隆来的仓库里配了什么，插件就照着运行什么。

## 安装

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:RicardoYan/dsh-workspace-trust#v0.2.1
```

Web 端把 `desktop` 换成你的 profile 名（一般是 `web`）。装完重启 DSH。

卸载：`dsh plugin --profile desktop remove dsh-workspace-trust`

## 使用

- 每个工作区第一次开会话时弹一次：**信任** / **不信任**，选完记住，不再问
- 工作区 = 从会话目录往上最近的含 `.dsh/settings.yml` 或 `.git` 的目录；都没有就是会话目录本身。同一工作区的子目录共用一个选择
- `/workspace-trust` 查看状态；`/workspace-trust trust` 或 `untrust` 修改，当前会话立即生效
- 记录在 `~/.dsh/workspace-trust/workspaces.json`，按路径保存；删除工作区目录不会清掉记录。之后同一路径放了别的项目（例如重新克隆了另一个仓库），会沿用原来的选择，必要时用 `/workspace-trust untrust` 改回

## 禁止访问列表

以下目录即使工作区已信任也不允许插件读取：`~/.dsh ~/.ssh ~/.gnupg ~/.aws ~/.azure ~/.kube ~/.docker ~/.git-credentials ~/.config/gh ~/.netrc ~/.npmrc ~/.pypirc ~/.claude ~/.codex ~/.cc-switch`。在 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 里调整：

```yaml
- id: dsh-workspace-trust
  name: 'dsh-workspace-trust'
  config:
    deniedPaths: ['~/.my-secrets', '%APPDATA%/some-tool']   # 追加
    useDefaultDeniedPaths: true                             # false = 不用上面的默认列表
```

## 注意

- 本插件只记录和检查，本身不运行项目代码；哪些功能受信任控制，由使用它的插件决定
- 依赖 DSH 的 `agent/pre-step`、`userQuestions`、`commands` 接口，适用于 `@deepseek-ai/dsh` `>=0.2.1-rc.1 <0.3.0-0`
- 没有界面（如 headless）时不弹询问，按未信任处理。关闭插件用 DSH 插件管理页的开关（会往 profile patch 写 `disabled`），插件没有自己的开关
- 禁止访问列表在插件详情页里配（`deniedPaths` / `useDefaultDeniedPaths`），也能手写进 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml`
- 界面文字跟随 DSH 的语言设置（设置 → 常规 → 语言），只显示中文或英文；语言设为自动时跟随系统语言。斜杠命令列表里的命令说明在 DSH 启动时确定，切换语言后重启才更新

## 许可证

MIT

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness plugin: create spec-compliant skills from the Web UI (Huawei Cloud / generic / REST API), with a 10-point evaluation loop
plugins.readme_text:
# Scenes Skill Creator

**在 DeepSeek Harness 的 Web 界面里真跑官方 creator 技能——通用技能 / 标准API管理技能 / 华为云基础云服务技能——并实时展示过程、自动评测、不达标就打回修改。**

[![npm version](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/@cloudplugin/dsh-skill-creator.svg)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@cloudplugin/dsh-skill-creator)
[![license: MIT](https://img.shields.io/npm/l/@cloudplugin/dsh-skill-creator.svg)](https://github.com/wasteoneslife/dsh-skill-creator/blob/main/LICENSE)

包名 `@cloudplugin/dsh-skill-creator`，是一个 DSH bundle（Host 半边 + Client 半边，全部在 Harness 进程内，没有子进程、没有监听端口）。

## 它是什么

官方 creator 技能（`common-skill-creator` / `rest-api-skill-creator` / `huawei-cloud-skill-creator`）是给命令行或会话里的 agent 用的：需求要自己写清、流程要自己盯、产物好不好要自己判断。本插件把这件事搬进 Web 界面：

1. **需求传递**：侧边栏选分类、填表单，插件把内容整理成 creator 能直接开工的请求（已经给全的值不再反问）。
2. **过程展示**：按下「开始创建」后，Host 侧新起一个**真 agent** 执行该 creator 自己的流水线，面板实时渲染阶段清单与步骤日志。
3. **评测闭环**：创建结束后真跑一遍 10 分制评测，不达标就把扣分明细交回**同一个** creator 就地修改，直到达标或用完轮数。

**插件自己不做内容创作**：SKILL.md 怎么写、references 怎么摆、脚本怎么跑，全部由该 creator 当前版本决定（插件不内嵌副本、不二次实现；上游改了，插件行为就跟着改）。

## ✨ 主要特性

- **分三类组织需求**：侧边栏为 通用技能 / 标准API管理技能 / 华为云基础云服务技能，创建记录按分类隔离，默认打开通用技能。
- **真跑，不止给提示词**：创建由 creator 技能在真 agent 里执行；步骤日志逐条记录它的工具调用、阶段切换与模型报错。
- **实时展示阶段与步骤**：阶段清单按 creator 自己的标记点亮（华为云 Phase 1–6 / 通用技能 阶段 1–5 / 标准API Step 1–4），运行中每 1 秒刷新。
- **自动评测并打回修改**：10 分制、通过线 8.5；不达标把扣分明细发回同一个 creator 修改，最多 3 轮，到顶输出评测报告。
- **无人值守也不提问**：提示词里禁止提问；creator 若仍然提问，插件按"只读、不执行变更类操作"的策略自动答复并继续（最多 5 次）。
- **保护长任务不被误杀**：看门狗按**静默**判死（默认静默 8 分钟、整段 120 分钟兜底），并识别进程被挂起（休眠）后重新计时。
- **回看历史并可靠落盘**：运行记录原子写入磁盘（临时文件 + 重命名 + 备份 + 与磁盘记录合并去重），bundle 重载或 DSH 重启后仍能重新打开，最多保留 20 条。
- **自动发现产物目录**：通用/标准API 模式没有名称与目录字段，评测阶段从 creator 写文件的路径、以及 `<cwd>/skills` 下新出现的 `SKILL.md` 自动定位产物。
- **按需拉取华为云三级目录**：只有切到华为云分类才访问仓库，逐级读取并缓存（默认每路径 10 分钟）；默认分类打开页面不发请求。

## 快速开始

两种安装方式。装完后**必须重启 DSH 一次**——bundle 列表与补丁层只在启动时解析（不重启的表现是侧边栏没有图标，或面板 API 404）。

**方式一 · DSH 内（任意 profile，推荐）**：在会话里让 agent 用 Harness 自带的插件管理安装这个 spec：

```text
@cloudplugin/dsh-skill-creator
```

**方式二 · 桌面端 profile（命令行）**：把**同一个包名**同时写进该 profile 的依赖与 `dsh.profile.bundles`（两处都要有）：

```sh
cd ~/.dsh/profiles/desktop
pnpm add @cloudplugin/dsh-skill-creator   # 或用 npm install
```

```powershell
cd $env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\profiles\desktop
pnpm add @cloudplugin/dsh-skill-creator   # 或用 npm install
```

> **⚠️ 装完必须重启 DSH 一次**（包与配置在启动时加载）。
>
> 另外，安装用的包名必须与 `src/client.js` 里 `window.__ModuleLoader__.load({ id })` 的 id 完全一致（本包都是 `@cloudplugin/dsh-skill-creator`），不一致时浏览器侧会直接报 `bundle … loaded without registering "…"`。

最小可用配置（写进 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml`，`id` 与包内补丁一致）：

```yaml
- id: dsh-skill-creator
  name: '@cloudplugin/dsh-skill-creator'
  config:
    run:
      cwd: '/absolute/path/to/your/workspace'
      permissionPreset: 'danger-full-access'
      passScore: 8.5
      maxEvalRounds: 3
      evalReadonlyOnly: true
      idleTimeoutMs: 480000
      phaseTimeoutMs: 7200000
      toolWaitMs: 1200000
```

`run.cwd` 是技能落盘根，产物写在 `<cwd>/skills/…`。不设时回落到 DSH host 进程的 cwd（通常是 profile 目录），技能会被写进 profile 里而不是你的工作区。上面的 `run` 键要写全，原因见「配置」一节的坑。

### 命令行安装（等价方式）

```sh
# Web / 普通 profile
dsh plugin add @cloudplugin/dsh-skill-creator

# 桌面端：先完全退出客户端，再指定 desktop profile
dsh plugin --profile desktop add @cloudplugin/dsh-skill-creator
```

装完**重启一次 DSH**。桌面端的 `dsh` CLI 随安装包提供（`resources\runtime\cli\bin\dsh.cmd`）；若手边没有该命令，也可以在插件页里直接填包名 `@cloudplugin/dsh-skill-creator` 安装。

## ⚠️ 权限要求（必读）

> **发布包默认 `run.permissionPreset: 'danger-full-access'`**（写在包内 `cordis.patch.yml` 里，不是文档假设）。
>
> 原因：creator 流程要跑 bash 脚本（`ensure_cli.sh` / `validate-skill.sh` / `test-cli-commands.sh`）与云 CLI，这些 fork 在只读或 `workspace-write` 沙箱下会被审批拦住。无人值守时没有人点「允许」，运行就静默，随后被看门狗判死——表现为**"跑一半超时退出"**（实跑数据里确有 `permission: null` 的运行以 `等待「creator」超时：已静默 8 分钟（无任何工具调用或文本）` 结束）。
>
> **风险**：创建与评测 agent 都会以完全访问权限运行（可读写文件、执行命令）。请只在**信任的工作区**使用本插件。若改成受限 preset，请确保有人在场处理审批，否则长任务大概率静默超时。

## 三种技能类型

| 显示名（侧边栏顺序） | 内部 `mode` | 委托的官方 creator | 来源 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 通用技能 | `generic` | `common-skill-creator` | [grape-skills](https://gitcode.com/grape-dev/grape-skills) `main` → `skills/coding/scaffolding/common-skill-creator` |
| 标准API管理技能 | `api` | `rest-api-skill-creator` | [grape-skills](https://gitcode.com/grape-dev/grape-skills) `main` → `skills/coding/scaffolding/rest-api-skill-creator` |
| 华为云基础云服务技能 | `huawei` | `huawei-cloud-skill-creator` | [huaweicloud-skills](https://gitcode.com/huaweicloud/huaweicloud-skills) `master` → `skills/devtools/common/huawei-cloud-skill-creator` |

- 显示名就是侧边栏菜单文案，**数组顺序即菜单顺序（华为云固定最后）**，默认选中第一项（通用技能）。
- 每个菜单项下方还有一行**说明小字**，标明该分类对应的 creator 家族：通用技能 `common-skill-dev` · 标准API管理技能 `common-restapi-skill-dev` · 华为云基础云服务技能 `huawei-skill`。
- 内部 `mode` 键是 Host API 契约（`POST /run` 的 `spec.mode`）与记录隔离键；改显示名不动它。
- **记录按分类隔离**：创建记录卡片只列出当前分类的历史。
- **三级目录按需拉取**：只有切到华为云分类才访问仓库（逐级读取，默认每路径缓存 10 分钟）。
- 三个 creator 都会按需注册为可加载的 DSH skill，缓存 24 小时，可点「从仓库拉取最新」强制刷新。

各分类要填什么：

| 分类 | 表单字段 |
| --- | --- |
| 通用技能 | 一个「技能功能描述」文本框（≥8 字符）。没有名称、目录、tags 字段——这些是打包约定，由该 creator 自己推导。 |
| 标准API管理技能 | 一个「REST API 技能需求」文本框（≥8 字符），占位符是一份需求模板：技能名称 / 一句话描述 / 目标系统 / API 地址 / 认证方式 / **API 文档**。 |
| 华为云基础云服务技能 | 一级目录（固定 `skills`，不可改）+ 二级目录 + 三级目录（均从仓库实时读取）+ 技能名（前缀 `huawei-cloud-` 固定，后缀 1–64 字符小写字母/数字/连字符）+「功能概括」文本框（可留空）。技能名即仓库路径第四级：`skills/<二级>/<三级>/<技能名>`。 |

**标准API模式里「API 文档」最关键**：该 creator 不猜端点——它解析你给的文档，或用 curl 实测探测；两者都拿不到就不产出。请把凭据放进环境变量，不要写在这段文本里。

## 工作流程

```text
填需求（选分类 + 填表单）
  └─ POST /dsh-skill-creator/api/run
       └─ Host：ctx.agents.create() 起一个真 agent
            agent.followup(creator 请求)           把需求交给 creator 技能
            ctx.on('agent/assistant-stream', …)    把流式帧转成阶段与步骤
       └─ 面板每 1 秒 GET /run?id=…                 渲染阶段清单 + 步骤日志

创建结束（creator 空闲）
  └─ 目标目录自动发现（通用/标准API 模式表单里没有名称，路径由 creator 决定）
       └─ 评测第 1 轮（真跑只读用例，10 分制）
            ├─ 得分 ≥ 8.5 ──────────────────────► done（附评测报告）
            └─ 得分 < 8.5 → 扣分明细 followup 回同一个 creator 就地修改（fixing）
                 └─ 评测第 2 轮 … 最多 3 轮
                      ├─ 本轮提升 < 0.2 ────────► below-threshold（早停，附报告）
                      └─ 3 轮到顶仍未达标 ──────► below-threshold（附报告）
```

运行状态：`creating` → `evaluating` →（`fixing` → `evaluating`）* → `done` / `below-threshold`；任何阶段都可能 `cancelled` / `failed`，进程重启后残留的进行中记录会标为 `interrupted`。运行中可「取消」，结束后可「← 返回」再开一次。

各 creator 的阶段清单（阶段标题就是面板上显示的文案，插件按 creator 自己的标记点亮，**只前进不回退**）：

| 分类 | 阶段 |
| --- | --- |
| 华为云 | Phase 1 · 需求分析（苏格拉底式问答） |
| 华为云 | Phase 2 · 技术调研（CLI→SDK→API 三级回退） |
| 华为云 | Phase 3 · 文档生成（SKILL.md + references + 载体） |
| 华为云 | Phase 4 · 测试准备（templates/test-vars.json） |
| 华为云 | Phase 5 · 详细测试（真实执行验证） |
| 华为云 | Phase 6 · 资源清理与合规检查 |
| 通用技能 | 阶段 1 · 需求分析 |
| 通用技能 | 阶段 2 · 设计 |
| 通用技能 | 阶段 3 · 生成（skill 包 + 模板） |
| 通用技能 | 阶段 4 · 验证（规范 + lint 检查点双通过） |
| 通用技能 | 阶段 5 · eval 迭代 |
| 标准API | Step 1 · 需求澄清 |
| 标准API | Step 2 · 技术调研 |
| 标准API | Step 3 · 骨架生成 |
| 标准API | Step 4 · 自测与收尾（创建 PR/交棒属平台流水线，本面板不做） |

## 评测机制（10 分制，通过线 8.5）

创建结束后**真跑一遍评测**：由评测 agent 在被测 skill 目录里执行只读用例，再由本地评分器按平台口径打分。

| 维度 | 满分 | 明细 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 稳定性 | 4 | 功能可用 3 + 触发词充足度 1 |
| 成本 | 1 | 消耗总 token |
| 效率 | 2 | 8 项 × 0.25：完成时间 / 工具失败次数 / 重试次数 / cli / sdk / api 调用次数 / LLM 调用次数 / 上下文是否压缩 |
| 安全 | 3 | 本地规则扫描：高危 ≥1 扣 3；告警 ≥2 扣 2；告警 1 扣 1 |

- **通过线 8.5/10**（即"85 分"）；分级参考平台：`=10` 技能满分、`[8,10)` 优质技能。
- **容差 10% 且单向**：成本与效率只罚超支、不罚更省；基线为 0 视为无参照。**但从第 2 轮起才与基线比较**——首轮不再"白送"（见下条）。
- **绝对上限始终生效**（`evalTokenBudget` / `evalDurationCapSeconds` / `evalMaxToolCalls` / `evalMaxLlmCalls` / cli·sdk·api 上限 / 工具失败与重试必须为 0）：无基线时按绝对上限判定，有基线时"≤ 基线×(1+10%)"与"≤ 绝对上限"**同时**满足才满分；更省永远不罚。默认值取自实测量级（评测轮 token 23965/28550/38999/39617、时长 42.5/58.2/65.75/394.1 s、工具调用 4-8、cli 2-6、llm 4-6、工具失败 0、重试 0），正常轮次不会误伤。
- **功能可用 = 外部证据，不是评测 agent 的自编用例**：必须真实执行**被测 skill 自带夹具**里的 ≥ `minFixtureCases`（默认 3）条只读/语法用例，每条带「执行命令 + 观测结果（退出码/输出片段）+ 与期望的对比结论」，且没有 `fail`。只有自编用例、缺证据、夹具不存在或用例数不足 → 这 3 分直接 0，理由写进 `checks.functionalEvidence`；自编用例只能作为补充。
- **本地门禁（确定性，不需要 agent）**：任一不过 → 总分压到 `gateScoreCap`（默认 7.0）并确保 `verdict !== 'pass'`，同时进扣分明细、修复提示词与报告。
  1. `SKILL.md` 存在且 frontmatter 可解析（name/description 都有）；
  2. 该 kind 的测试夹具存在且可解析；
  3. `validateSkillPackage` 结构校验 error 为 0（读 `level` 字段——曾误读 `severity`，于是"恒 0 error"）；
  4. 华为云 kind：creator 自带的 `scripts/validate-skill.sh` 执行后不得有 FAIL（跑不了 bash 只记 warning，不作门禁）。
- **只跑只读/语法用例**：按 kind 取自带夹具里的用例，最多 20 条，**写操作一律不执行**（

plugins.description: Give DeepSeek Harness eyes and hands: live click-through screen preview plus real mouse/keyboard control on Windows.
plugins.readme_text: # dsh-tentacle 给鲸鱼娘一双眼睛和一只手。 **English**：Give DeepSeek Harness a pair of eyes and a hand — live screen capture with a click-through preview panel, plus real mouse and keyboard control on Windows. - **眼睛**：`screen_look` 把屏幕截成 JPEG 落盘，模型用 `read_image` 真看；Web GUI 里还有一个 可拖动、可缩放的实时预览面板，点一下画面就能反向操作你的电脑。 - **手**：`pc_control` 用真实的 Win32 `SendInput` 驱动鼠标键盘——点击、双击、右键、拖动、滚轮、 打字（含中文/emoji）、快捷键。 - **刹车**：`pc_pause` 或面板上的「暂停」是同一个急停开关；暂停后只能看，不能动。 只支持 Windows：截屏靠 Pillow，输入注入靠 `SendInput`。 ## 组成 | 文件 | 作用 | | --- | --- | | `helper/tentacle.py` | 常驻 Python 助手：Pillow 截屏 + ctypes `SendInput` 输入注入，stdio JSON 行协议 | | `lib/index.js` | Host 半：四个工具 + `/tentacle/{frame,state,pause,input}` 路由，管理助手进程与限流 | | `lib/client.js` | 浏览器半：左下角「鲸鱼之眼」浮窗，190ms 拉一帧，转发点击/拖拽/滚轮/打字 | | `cordis.patch.yml` | 把插件插进 profile 的层栈 | ## 工具 ### `screen_look` ``` screen_look(max_width=1280, quality=55, monitor=0, grid=false, region={x,y,width,height}) ``` 返回 `{ ok, path, imageWidth, imageHeight, origin, scaleX, scaleY, screenRect, cursor, activeWindow, monitors }`。 - 图片默认缩到 1280 宽，`scaleX = 屏幕宽 / 图像宽`，`图像坐标 × scaleX + origin.x` 就是屏幕坐标。 - `grid:true` 会在图上画红色坐标网格，**标签直接就是屏幕物理像素**，可以直接喂给 `pc_control`。 - `region` 是屏幕像素的裁剪框，用来放大局部看清细节（高分辨率下找小按钮用）。 - 暂停时依然能截屏：看不受刹车影响。 ### `pc_control` ``` pc_control(action="click", x=962, y=540) pc_control(action="type", text="你好，鲸鱼娘") pc_control(action="hotkey", keys=["ctrl","s"]) ``` 动作：`move` / `click` / `double_click` / `right_click` / `middle_click` / `drag` / `scroll` / `type` / `key` / `hotkey` / `wait`。坐标一律是屏幕物理像素。 ### `pc_state` 显示器布局、屏幕尺寸、光标位置、前台窗口、助手健康状态、面板心跳。很便宜，动手前先看一眼。 ### `pc_pause` 急停 / 恢复，和预览面板的按钮共用同一个状态。 ## 面板 左下角浮窗，标题「鲸鱼之眼」： - 实时画面（约 5 fps），拖头部移动，右下角拖拽改大小； - 在画面上左键点 = 点击、双击 = 双击、右键 = 右键、按住拖 = 拖动、滚轮 = 滚动； - 底部可以给前台窗口打一段字，或者点 `Esc` / `Enter` / `Tab` / `Backspace`； - 「暂停」= 急停；「×」收起，点左下角 👁 再出来； - 位置和大小存在 localStorage。 ## 安装 ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-tentacle ``` 装完重启 `dsh web`，刷新页面，左下角就会出现「鲸鱼之眼」。 不走 npm 也可以直接从 GitHub 装： ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add github:githu-mensk/dsh-tentacle ``` 手动安装也行： ```jsonc // ~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/package.json { "dependencies": { "dsh-tentacle": "link:E:/dswork/plugins/dsh-tentacle" }, "dsh": { "profile": { "bundles": [ /* ... */, "dsh-tentacle" ] } } } ``` 然后 `pnpm install`，重启 DeepSeek Harness。浏览器半要刷新页面才出现。 ## 安全 - 急停是进程内的共享开关，面板和工具都听它的；暂停期间 `pc_control` 直接拒绝。 - 所有路由先过 `connection.requestRejection`，非本地连接一律拒绝。 - 截图落在 `$DSH_HOME/storages/tentacle/look/`，只保留最近 40 张。 - 删文件、卸载、付款、发送这类破坏性点击，模型仍然要先问过你。 ## 回滚 从 profile 的 `bundles` 里删掉 `dsh-tentacle`，删掉 dependency，重启即可； 插件目录 `E:\dswork\plugins\dsh-tentacle` 可以整个删掉。 ## 限制 - 只支持 Windows（`SendInput` + `PIL.ImageGrab`）。 - 靠 Pillow 截屏，1280 宽一帧约 70–90ms，所以面板实际 5–8 fps，不是 60 帧视频。 - 高 DPI 下会自动声明 per-monitor aware，坐标是物理像素，不是逻辑像素。 - 多显示器：`monitor` 选第几块屏，`all_monitors:true` 截整个虚拟桌面；点击坐标是虚拟桌面绝对坐标。

plugins.description: 在每条回答下方常驻显示本轮 Token 用量、回答耗时与会话累计 Token / Per-reply token usage, answer duration and session total for DeepSeek Harness
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-token-clock

每条回答的下方，一行淡色读数：**本轮 Token** · **回答耗时** · **本会话累计 Token**。

![预览](assets/preview.png)

```
[复制] [赞/踩] [分支] [↗]    20:10   1.1M tok · 1分02秒 · 共 26.9M tok
```

从左到右每一段：

| 片段 | 含义 |
| --- | --- |
| `20:10` | 官方结束时间（宿主自带，非本插件） |
| `1.1M tok` | 本轮 Token：这一次提问→回答的消耗 |
| `1分02秒` | 回答耗时：提问→回答落盘的墙钟时间 |
| `共 26.9M tok` | 本会话累计 Token |


- **数据来源**：本轮读数取自宿主的 `turn-tail` 节点，与官方「用量」弹窗同一口径；会话累计读 `tokenUsage` 投影，实时更新。
- **常驻可见**：官方动作行只在最后一条回答上常显，历史回答要悬停才出现；本插件仅对含读数的行解除该限制。
- **精确分解**：鼠标悬停读数，可看到未缓存输入 / 缓存读取 / 缓存写入 / 输出 / 其中推理的精确数字。

## 安装

**方式一：插件市场（推荐）**

插件收录到 DSH 插件市场后，在 Harness 里打开「插件市场」搜索 `dsh-token-clock` 即可一键安装。

**方式二：本地目录 / Release 包**

1. 下载 [v1.0.0 的 tarball](https://github.com/oxygenforce/dsh-token-clock/releases/download/v1.0.0/dsh-token-clock-1.0.0.tgz) 并解压（内部是 `package/` 目录）；
2. 在 Harness 的插件管理页选择「从本地目录安装」，指向解压出来的 `package/` 目录；
3. 安装后刷新一次 Web 页面，读数即刻出现，不需要重启 `dsh web`。

> 本包同时带有 `dsh.bundle.patch` 与 `cordis.patch.yml`，两条安装路径都会按 bundle 正常启用。

## 兼容性

- 面向 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-chat` / `dsh-client-ui-conversation` 的 `0.2.1-rc.2` 客户端契约（`conversation.chat.turnTail` 槽位、`turn-tail` 节点数据）。
- 纯客户端插件：Host 半边只做日志占位，不注册任何服务、不读写文件、不发网络请求。
- 所有样式都走 `--dsw-alias-*` 主题令牌，深浅色自动跟随；仅注入一个 `<style>` 标签与一个槽位条目。

## 实现要点

| 关注点 | 做法 |
| --- | --- |
| 放置位置 | 注册到 `conversation.chat.turnTail`（`order: -10`），用 `react-dom` portal 把读数接在官方动作行的结束时间之后；取不到动作行时原地降级渲染 |
| 分隔线定位 | `centerRule()` 在 portal 完成后实测“正文底边 → 线 → 动作行顶边”，用 `transform: translateY()` 视觉位移（不动 margin，避免流式渲染时触发滚动锚定跳动） |
| 跟随补底 | 宿主按“撑高后”的内容高度发起平滑滚动，元素塌陷后目标失效会把视图留在半空；插件只在“塌陷前贴底、且不是读者主动滚动”时补一次贴底 |
| 失败策略 | 组件内部 `try/catch`，任何异常都返回 `null`，绝不连累对话界面 |

## 许可

plugins.description: 归档工作台（DeepSeek Harness 插件）：在侧边栏会话菜单中永久删除会话，并提供归档会话面板，可一键恢复或删除已归档会话。
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-archive-workbench

**归档工作台** — DeepSeek Harness 的会话删除 + 归档管理插件。

**中文** | [English](README.en.md)

DeepSeek Harness 官方只能**归档**会话（隐藏，不删盘），也没有一个方便的地方查看已归档的会话。这个插件补上这两块：

1. **永久删除会话** —— 侧边栏会话行的「...」菜单里多一项「删除会话」，真正删掉磁盘上的日志，而不是只隐藏。
2. **归档会话面板** —— 侧边栏底部多一个归档图标，点开是一整页已归档会话列表，每行可**恢复归档**或**删除**。

---

## 截图

**归档会话面板** —— 侧边栏的「已归档会话」，每行可恢复归档或删除：

![归档会话面板](assets/archived-panel.png)

**删除确认弹窗** —— 从会话菜单或面板删除时都会弹出：

![删除确认弹窗](assets/delete-confirm.png)

---

## 功能

### 1. 会话菜单：删除会话

在任一会话行的「...」菜单最下方（`复制 Session ID` 之后，带分隔线）：

> 置顶 → 重命名 → 分叉 → 归档 → 复制 Session ID → **删除会话**

点击后弹出确认框，确认即永久删除：

- 删除该会话**自己的**日志目录（`~/.dsh/sessions/<项目>/<会话ID>/`）
- 清理它的投影缓存（`~/.dsh/storages/session_projcache/sessions/<会话ID>.json`）
- 把该 id 从归档/置顶集合以及**工作区的会话顺序列表**里移除（不留下持久化的孤儿 id）
- 通知前端**立即移除该行**（无需刷新页面）
- 如果删掉的正是**当前打开的会话**，主区域自动回到新会话页，不会卡在一个已删除的会话上

**已归档的会话同样支持** —— 菜单项不区分状态。

### 2. 归档会话面板

侧边栏底部图标栏（与「插件」「定时」并排）多一个**归档图标**，点开后在主区域显示整页列表：

```
已归档会话  2
归档的会话会显示在这里，可随时恢复或删除。

┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ 会话标题                              [恢复归档] [删除]   │
│ session-cf676d08-1890-427e-aa64-34a910d31600            │
│ 工作区：dsh-test                                         │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

- 每行显示**标题 + 原始会话 ID + 所属工作区**（取不到标题时显示「未命名会话」）
- **恢复归档**：调官方 `unarchiveSession`，该行立即消失，会话回到原工作区位置；成功后底部有 aria-live 提示
- **删除**：复用同一个确认框，永久删除
- 顺序：**最近归档的在最上**
- 归档超过 6 条时出现**搜索框**，可按标题、会话 ID、路径或工作区过滤
- 首次加载显示「正在加载归档会话…」，不会先闪一行「未命名」
- 空状态：「还没有归档的会话。」

> 顺便说明：官方其实也有查看归档会话的入口（侧边栏顶部「视图选项」→ 全部对话（显示已归档）），但入口较深，且那里没有恢复/删除按钮 —— 恢复还得回到会话行的「...」菜单。本面板把这两件事集中到一个地方。

---

## 安装

**方式一：插件市场**（推荐）

在 DeepSeek Harness 里打开 设置 → 插件，搜索 `dsh-archive-workbench`。

**方式二：命令行**

```bash
dsh plugin add dsh-archive-workbench
```

**方式三：从 GitHub 直接安装**

```bash
dsh plugin add https://github.com/CHYMZXS/dsh-archive-workbench
```

**方式四：本地开发目录**

```bash
dsh plugin add /path/to/dsh-archive-workbench
```

安装后**重启一次 DeepSeek Harness**（插件含 Host 端代码，首次安装需要重启生效）。

---

## 配置

Host 端声明了 Config schema，可在插件设置里调整（都有默认值，不配也能用）：

| 配置项 | 默认值 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| `idleTimeoutMs` | `8000` | 删除驻留会话时，等待它空闲的上限（毫秒） |
| `settleAttempts` | `6` | 删完后复查日志是否被重建的次数 |
| `settleDelayMs` | `250` | 每次复查之间的间隔（毫秒） |
| `maxBodyBytes` | `4096` | 删除路由接受的请求体上限（字节） |
| `sessionsRoot` | `""` | 自定义会话根目录；留空则用 `DSH_HOME/sessions` 或 `~/.dsh/sessions` |

---

## 已知限制

### 正在运行的会话（重要）

DeepSeek Harness **没有**任何公开 API 能让一个会话从内存中退出。因此对于**本次运行中打开过、还驻留在内存里**的会话，删除文件不够 —— 它可能立刻把日志重新写回来。

插件的处理方式是：

1. 先调用官方 `archiveSession({ stopActivity: true })`，停掉它正在跑的工作并封住后续写入
2. 等它空闲（最多 `idleTimeoutMs`）
3. 再删文件
4. 删完**反复复查**（最多 `settleAttempts` 次）确认文件没有重新出现

如果文件仍然被重建，插件会**明确报错**并且**把归档状态回滚**（不会留下一个"删失败却被归档了"的会话）：

> the session is still resident in this application and keeps recreating its log; restart the application and delete it again

**建议**：如果要删的是"当前正在用/刚用过"的会话，**先重启一次应用再删** —— 重启后它变成冷会话，删除是干净的。

### 找不到日志目录

如果会话在存储里存在、但在当前会话根目录下找不到对应文件夹，插件返回 **409** 并提示检查 `DSH_HOME` 或 `sessionsRoot`，而不是假装删成功。反过来，如果存储里和磁盘上都已经没有这个会话，重复删除是**幂等成功**（`alreadyGone: true`），方便脚本重试。

### 附件不会被删除

`~/.dsh/attachments/` 里的图片/附件**不会**被删除。它们按内容哈希全局共享，多个会话可能引用同一个对象 —— 按会话去删会破坏其他会话。也正因如此，删一个会话回收的空间通常**远小于**它在附件目录里的占用。

### 子智能体会话

子智能体（subagent）产生的会话**不会**出现在侧边栏，因此无法从 UI 删除。这是官方行为。

---

## 安全性

删除路由不是裸露的：

- 先过 `connection.requestRejection(req)` —— 与官方 Web 路由相同的 Host/Origin 校验 + 浏览器认证，未通过返回 401/403
- 只接受 `Content-Type: application/json`（否则 415），杜绝跨站「简单请求」表单提交
- 校验 `sessionId` 字符集与长度，拒绝 `..` 与路径分隔符
- 所有 JSON 响应带 `cache-control: no-store`

---

## 工作原理

插件完全建立在官方扩展点上，**不修改官方任何一行代码**：

| 部分 | 用到的官方扩展点 |
|---|---|
| 删除菜单项 | `sidebar.workspaces.session.menu.item` 槽位（官方为插件预留，order 500） |
| 确认弹窗 | `shell.overlay` 槽位 + **插件自绘**的 Modal / Button（不 import 官方 UI 包） |
| 归档面板图标 | `sidebar.panellist` 槽位（order 20） |
| 归档面板页面 | `main` 键值槽位（key = `dsh-archive-workbench-archived`） |
| 删除动作 | Host 端 `ctx.webServer.register()` 注册私有路由；客户端 `fetch` 调用 |
| 前端移除行 | 发官方 `api-session/removed` 事件（在官方转发白名单内） |
| 恢复归档 | 官方 `uiWorkspace.unarchiveSession()` |
| 清理工作区顺序 | 官方 `Workspace.detachSession()` |
| 清理投影缓存 | 官方 `storageDomain` 的 `table.delete()` |

删除逻辑在 Host 端（`index.js`），UI 在客户端（`client.js`），通过一条私有 HTTP 路由通信。

> **为什么 UI 是自绘的？** 官方文档明确写着：普通 JS 插件不要 `require()` Harness 的客户端包（如 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-primitives`）—— 它们不是插件 API，随版本改动，而且一个组件抛错会让整个 slot 条目变成空白。本插件只依赖 `react`，按钮/弹窗/图标全部自带，外观通过 `--dsw-alias-*` 主题变量与官方保持一致；四个 slot 条目各自包了 error boundary，单点出错不会拖垮整个界面。

---

## 开发

```bash
git clone https://github.com/CHYMZXS/dsh-archive-workbench
cd dsh-archive-workbench
npm install
npm test
dsh plugin add .
```

- `npm test` 跑 `node:test` 冒烟测试（id 校验、路径解码、配置钳制、目录查找）。
- 改完 `client.js` 会自动热重载；改 `index.js`（Host 端）需要重启应用。

---

## License

MIT

plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-mcp-skills

一个 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) 插件，在网页设置面板中新增两个管理页面：

- **Skills** — 浏览、导入、删除、开关用户自有技能（存放于 `$DSH_HOME/skills`）。
- **MCP** — 管理 MCP 服务器配置（stdio / Streamable HTTP），支持增删改与连接测试。启用的服务器写入当前 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml`，重启后自动连接，工具注册为 `mcp__<server>__<tool>`。

## 截图

**Skills 页面**

![Skills 页面](images/skills.png)

**MCP 页面**

![MCP 页面](images/mcp.png)

## 安装

要求：已安装带 web profile 的 dsh，且 `PATH` 中有 `pnpm`。

从 npm 安装：

```
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-mcp-skills
```

从 GitHub 安装：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/Lrxc/dsh-manage-hub.git
```

或从本地目录：

```sh
git clone https://github.com/Lrxc/dsh-manage-hub.git
dsh plugin --profile web add file:./dsh-manage-hub
```

重启：

```sh
dsh --profile web
```

## 行为说明

- MCP 服务器保存在 `$DSH_HOME/mcp-servers.yaml`；启用的服务器会被写入当前 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml`，重启 dsh 后自动连接。插件只增删自己生成的 `mcp-*` 行，不改动该文件的其他内容：注释、锚点与 `!!js` 表达式都会原样保留，写入是原子的，并会保留一份 `.bak` 备份。
- 若 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 存在语法错误，插件会拒绝改写并报错，而不是覆盖它。
- 连接测试 15 秒超时，超时会关闭连接并回收子进程。测试与真实挂载使用同一套环境清洗规则：`*_KEY` / `*_PASSWORD` / `*_SECRET` / `*_TOKEN` 与 `DSH_*` 变量不会传给 MCP 子进程，需要凭据时请在服务器的环境变量里显式配置。
- 技能存放在 `$DSH_HOME/skills`。zip 导入支持单个技能（根目录 `SKILL.md` 或 `<name>/SKILL.md`）或多个技能目录，`template/` 会被跳过，已存在的技能不会被覆盖（导入结果会显示跳过数量）。
- 「测试」按钮使用宿主安装自带的 MCP SDK（列为可选 peer 依赖，不随本包重复安装）。若宿主未提供该 SDK，只有这一个按钮会提示不可用，技能管理与其余 MCP 功能不受影响。

## 卸载

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-mcp-skills
```

如不再需要，删除 profile `cordis.patch.yml` 中生成的 `mcp-*` 行及 `$DSH_HOME/mcp-servers.yaml`。



## 开发

发布到npm

```shell
# 1. 用官方 registry 重新登录（务必带 --registry，否则会登到镜像站）
npm login --registry=https://registry.npmjs.org --auth-type=web
# 2. 确认包名可用
npm view dsh-mcp-skills version
# 3. 检查 tarball（务必含 cordis.patch.yml）
npm pack --dry-run
# 4. 发布（稳定版，不要 prerelease）
npm publish
```



## License

MIT
